rule.statement: A nomination under the Land Development Ordinance becomes effective only if it is duly registered before the date of the death of the owner of the holding or the permit-holder.
rule.supporting_quote: According to section 60 of the Land Development Ordinance, referred to above, a nomination would become effective, only if such nomination or cancellation is duly registered before the date of the death of the owner of the holding or the permit-holder.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 60 of the Land Development Ordinance
